title: Notification System
prompt: Design a notification service that other internal services call to send push, email and SMS notifications to users. It must respect user preferences, retry failures and never spam users with duplicates.
functionalReqs: Send push / email / SMS via one API
Respect user channel preferences and opt-outs
nonFunctionalReqs: At-least-once delivery with deduplication (no double sends)
One slow provider must not block other channels
Soft real-time: < 5 s for transactional messages

scale.qps: ~10M notifications/day avg, bursts of 100K/s for campaigns
scale.storage: ~1 KB per notification log entry, 90-day retention

deepDives: Preferences and rate limiting per user
